title: Progressive WebView startup
summary: Render four critical Home routes before secondary Home data, expose critical/full startup timing, and preserve ordered execution while deferring external scripts until HTML parsing completes.
reason: Initial Home rendering waited on a broad route batch and the backend-served index loaded its large ordered script graph without browser loading hints.
behavior_before: The first automatic Home refresh waited for every Home route before rendering and external scripts could block HTML parsing.
behavior_after: Health, snapshot, close-readiness, and telemetry render first; the normal Home batch follows immediately. External scripts remain ordered but use defer, and a read-only startup-performance event reports both milestones.
manual_validation: targeted critical-refresh static test and node --check app.js (pass)
performance benchmark candidate (pass; all 187 current external scripts carry defer)
rollback_plan: Remove initialCritical refresh handling and startup timing dispatch, remove defer attributes from index scripts, and remove the served-script defer policy/tests.
notes:
Split initial Home refresh into critical and secondary phases and emit startup timing evidence.
Mark all ordered external scripts defer so HTML can paint before execution.
Ensure served external scripts retain ordered defer hints.
Apply deferred-script policy after static include expansion.
Cover ordered script deferral and rendered index behavior.
Guard critical-first Home refresh and startup timing evidence.
Refresh generated summary for the performance change.
